exact_text: Any person operating a bicycle, electric bicycle, or electric scooter shall obey the instructions of official traffic-control signals, signs and other control devices applicable to vehicles, unless otherwise directed by a Police Officer.

source_review.activation: A source-visible official device must give an instruction applicable to vehicles on this approach; operator identity and approach/route must be source-bound.
source_review.ordinary_branch: With no contrary Police Officer direction, compare original operator response to the applicable device instruction.
source_review.exception_branch: When a Police Officer otherwise directs the operator, capture the officer's actual instruction, timing, visibility/applicability and the operator response. A controller request or officer actor alone does not establish the exception.
source_review.conflict_requirement: For a controlled comparison, the officer instruction must genuinely differ from the device instruction while map, approach, device, operator type, rate and cameras remain fixed.
source_review.unreviewed_summary_rule: The recovered summary is a planning aid; no required-observation term is treated as a pinned Core atom or an accepted legal criterion.

cpu_delivery_plan.baseline: Retain a neutral approach stage but do not select it as a recording.
selected_case_targets: same-cell official device instruction without contrary officer direction
same-cell opposite Police Officer direction with observed response
original_channels: operator Native identity, pose, velocity and control by frame
device identity, displayed state, approach applicability and time interval
officer identity, direction content, origin and time interval
cpu_delivery_plan.negative_fixture: Remove officer direction source or corrupt applicability join; saved audit must reject the exception case.
cpu_delivery_plan.positive_fixture: Synthetic 20 Hz original-like histories must exercise both directions and source joins; this proves only saved software logic.
cpu_delivery_plan.comparison_audit: Verify the device instruction, approach, actor type, camera contract and environmental controls are held fixed; the officer instruction is the deliberate difference.
cpu_delivery_plan.candidate_requirement: Each selected case needs primary plus three law-preserving fallback construction plans with distinct source-measurable triggers, exact offline and positive/negative compatibility proofs. None exists yet.

capability_questions: Does the pinned Native environment expose a controllable bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter operator with original body and control traces?
Can a Police Officer actor visibly and measurably issue a specific instruction in the frozen alley cell?
Can an applicable official device with conflicting instruction be represented and independently read back in the alley?
physical_checks_later: actual actor availability and direction rendering
original Native behavior and camera pixels
